title: Larger question pilot with early checkpoints and speaker-matched audio

tasks.label: Keep the current questions and audio unchanged
tasks.note: The existing question files, answer labels, reader outputs and published audio are preserved. New pilot data is stored separately.

tasks.label: Choose more question times, including opportunities around 5–10 minutes
tasks.note: Prepared 24 past-only transcript cutoffs across six conversations: 18 early controls near five, 7.5 and ten minutes, plus six later points. Actual time deviations are recorded; AMI points avoid cutting words.

tasks.label: Generate a larger pool with three clearly defined methods
tasks.note: Four sequential vLLM jobs produced 78 model drafts across full-transcript, source-pair and concise writing prompts. 15 model saved phrasings retained with documented source/role corrections; 36 saved phrasings written by Codex add separate supervised examples.

tasks.label: Check natural wording, requester motivation and required evidence
tasks.note: The report now counts 43 distinct questions, with eight alternative phrasings kept underneath them. Four former topic groups were split because their control questions ask for different facts.

tasks.label: Test the 30B reader, including incomplete evidence and growing context
tasks.note: Historical reader controls cover 51 saved texts for 43 distinct questions, without the spoken cue. Main requested facts were correct in 45/51 full-context answers; the cue update did not rerun the reader.

tasks.label: Generate selected questions in the original requester’s voice
tasks.note: Thirty cue-bearing outputs plus four targeted slower outputs were generated from the same past requester references; all model weights are unchanged.

tasks.label: Check wording and speaker match; assemble short paused-meeting clips
tasks.note: All ten cue-bearing clips preserve source context and continuation exactly. Eight strict Parakeet matches, one spoken contraction and one filler discrepancy between ASR models are shown for listening.

tasks.label: Publish questions, results and playable audio; verify the live page
tasks.note: The question-level reports and cue-bearing clips are deployed. Pages 40429515191 succeeded and 187 live files matched; the final checklist sync is being verified.

tasks.label: Add and verify the spoken Assistant cue in the latest ten clips
tasks.note: The first spoken word is Assistant in all ten final clips, recovered by both Parakeet and CPU Whisper. The timeline cue uses slower synthesis after a disagreement in the first check. Live duplex triggering remains untested.

scope: New pilot; earlier questions and audio are preserved.

resource_plan.text: One A100/H100 SXM 80 GB per job; resident Qwen3-30B Instruct weights and cache on GPU 0, using vLLM.
resource_plan.tts: One L40S 48 GB per job; F5-TTS and its vocoder share GPU 0.
resource_plan.evaluation: One L40S 48 GB per job; ASR and speaker checks run sequentially on GPU 0.
resource_plan.dependencies: Text generation, source review and reading precede final TTS; audio checks precede publication.
